purpose: Teach: 病状/横綱/法王/君臨/演目/直訳/装い/床下

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時、本気で、絶対、人の病状、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, you've written some genuinely impressive papers on historical figures during wartime. I'm really impressed by the depth of your research.
lines.style: Warm, appreciative tone. Measured pace. Genuine interest — not performing encouragement. Eyes engaged, shoulders open. A teacher noticing real work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。江戸時代の、本気で、絶対、横綱、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you very much. I actually wrote quite a bit on the Edo period, particularly about the role of yokozuna in society. I'm grateful for the chance to explore such a rich area of study.
lines.style: Earnest gratitude. Slight stiffness from being praised — he's not used to it. Careful word choice. Respectful register to the teacher. Breath deepens as he talks about his actual interest.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 中世の、本気で、絶対、法王、絶対、政治、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And your coverage of medieval papal politics was remarkably thorough. Your scope is quite impressive — you really understand how to see the bigger picture.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured cadence. She's genuinely impressed and letting that show. Slight lean forward. No rush in the delivery. The warmth of recognizing a student who thinks deeply.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古代の、本気で、絶対、王朝が、絶対、君臨、絶対、した時代、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I focused quite a bit on the ancient dynasties and how power was consolidated during those reigns. I'm grateful you took the time to read through it all.
lines.style: Quieter here — still earnest, but almost humble. He's processing being seen. Slight pause before 'ancient dynasties' as he gathers himself. Respectful but not stiff.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 伝統芸能の、本気で、絶対、演目、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your work on traditional performing arts was really something special too. I could tell you'd done real thinking about those subjects.
lines.style: Engaged and present. Slightly brighter energy than before — she's clearly warming to talking about his work. Conversational but still formal enough for the context. A genuine smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古典の、本気で、絶対、直訳、絶対、と、絶対、意訳、絶対、比較、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I spent a lot of time comparing literal and free translations of classical texts to understand the nuances. It was deep research, and I'm really grateful you recognized the effort.
lines.style: More animated now — when he talks about what he actually did, his voice steadies. The technical detail gives him ground. Still respectful but less guarded. Growing confidence in his own work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 当時の貴族の、本気で、絶対、装い、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the detail you went into about how nobles dressed and presented themselves during that era — that showed real insight into the historical moment.
lines.style: Reflective and observant. She's clearly been impressed throughout his work. Steady, assured delivery. The voice of someone who reads carefully and notices what students put in. Affirming but not over-the-top.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古民家の、本気で、絶対、床下、絶対、構造、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you very much. I actually went into quite a bit of detail about the structural engineering of old houses — the foundation systems and floor construction. It was detailed work, and I'm truly grateful for your careful reading.
lines.style: Close to finished — there's a subtle completion in his tone now. Still earnest but less stiff than the first response. The relief of being truly heard. Quiet satisfaction in his voice. A small lift at the end.
